message.content:
This looks like the Prep Cutting Board System from the Commerce AD/CVD scope on wooden cabinets or similar. The most likely classification is wooden kitchenware under HTSUS 4419. Cutting boards of wood are classified in 4419.90.9000 (other tableware and kitchenware of wood), and the 2022 statistical suffixes are 4419.90.91 for other.

Sets: the board is the essential character, with steel accessories, so it is classified as a composite good or set by the wooden board. Under GRI 3(b), the wood cutting board gives the set its essential character.

Current HTSUS 4419: 4419.11 (bread boards, chopping boards and similar boards), 4419.12 (chopsticks), 4419.19 (other, bamboo), 4419.20 (tropical wood tableware and kitchenware), 4419.90 (other). Since the board is of tropical wood (acacia), 4419.20 applies. Within it, 4419.20.20 is for tropical wood tableware and kitchenware, and the suffix is 4419.20.2000, or 4419.20.4000 for other. I'm unsure of the exact structure; my best recollection is that 4419.20.20 covers "Tropical wood: tableware and kitchenware" in the 2022 edition, with 4419.20.2000 as the 10-digit code.
